en.title: 10 Must-Watch Crime Series Now Streaming on Prime Video
en.summary: From gripping true-crime docuseries to sprawling international thrillers, Prime Video's crime catalog is deep. Here are 10 essential watches for any fan of the genre.
en.body:
Crime dramas have long been the backbone of television, and Prime Video continues this legacy with a robust collection of shows that offer everything from intricate police procedurals to high-stakes international intrigue. Whether you're drawn to real-life mysteries or fictional tales of corruption and justice, this platform delivers.

## 1. A Body in the Snow: The Trial of Karen Read
This gripping true-crime docuseries plunges viewers into the complex and controversial case of Karen Read, accused of murdering her boyfriend. Its high Rotten Tomatoes score (96% critics, 94% audience) signals a meticulously investigated and compelling narrative that dissects the evidence and legal proceedings.

## 2. The Americans
FX's masterpiece, available on Prime Video, remains a benchmark for spy thrillers. Following two KGB agents posing as a suburban American couple during the Cold War, it masterfully blends domestic drama with espionage, earning critical acclaim for its writing and performances.

## 3. Mission: Impossible
While primarily a film franchise, the inclusion of the *Mission: Impossible* series (with scores like 92% critics, 73% audience) on a list of crime shows suggests a focus on its heist and espionage elements. These films are renowned for their intricate plots and jaw-dropping stunts.

## 4. The Sinner
This anthology crime drama, boasting an 89% critic score, excels at exploring the psychological depths of its characters. Each season presents a new mystery where the focus is not on *who* committed the crime, but *why*, making for a uniquely compelling viewing experience.

## 5. Professor T
With a solid 75% audience score, this Belgian import (also adapted in the UK) offers a fresh take on the procedural. It centers on a brilliant but eccentric criminal psychology professor who assists police, providing a sharp, character-driven angle to crime-solving.

## 6. The Rookie
While its critic score sits at 54%, *The Rookie*'s 83% audience score speaks volumes about its appeal. This series follows a man who joins the LAPD in his 40s, offering a relatable and often humorous look at the challenges of law enforcement from a unique perspective.

## 7. Goliath
This legal drama, featuring Billy Bob Thornton, dives deep into the underbelly of the justice system. It’s a compelling story of a washed-up lawyer seeking redemption by taking on a seemingly unwinnable case against a powerful law firm.

## 8. Reacher
Based on Lee Child's bestselling novels, *Reacher* is a lean, mean, and satisfying action-thriller. Alan Ritchson embodies the stoic, formidable Jack Reacher, delivering brutal efficiency and sharp dialogue that fans of the books and hard-boiled crime stories crave.

## 9. ZeroZeroZero
This visually stunning and complex drama traces the cocaine trade from its origins in Mexico through its journey to Italy. Its sprawling narrative, featuring Gabriel Byrne, and its on-location filming offer a gritty, immersive look at the global drug trade.

## 10. Scarpetta
This star-studded crime thriller, featuring Oscar winners Nicole Kidman and Jamie Lee Curtis, promised a high-caliber experience. While details on its specific plot are scarce in the research, the involvement of such talent suggests a sophisticated and engaging narrative.

Bottom Line: Prime Video's crime selection is a treasure trove for fans, blending critical darlings with crowd-pleasers for a truly binge-worthy experience.

content_raw: Crime has been one of the signature genres on TV for decades, and Prime Video is home to several great shows people should be watching.
